notes.title: ALL GRAPHICS REVAMPED!!!
notes.content:
Version 0.50.004/2702

Massive update in EONIA as regards graphics, assets and art in general. New rocks! New trees! New buildings!
My original idea was to make the art of EONIA as simple as possible. No effects. No details. Only the simple texture wrapping everything. But then I wanted to try something different and, from my humble opinion, now it looks better than ever.
From now on, the graphics of EONIA -without losing its characteristic hand painted style of course- will feature bump mapping, metallic and every possible effect. This way, each object will look more vivid and I hope you will like this change as much as I do.
Of course, this is a big modification in a game of the magnitude of EONIA, so naturally, to update all the world will take some time. But the result will be delightful! Thank you, as always, for all the support you give me every day! Regards, Juan.

notes.title: FLINO PET!!! UPDATE 0.35.004/0509
notes.content:
As with the NPCs, this is a transcendental update. Flino will be your pet. That inseparable companion of adventures that will follow you as your own shadow and will assist you without rest. It will help you to distract npcs and animals, creatures and beats, to grab unreachable objects, to activate unreachable levers and will show you the way if you do not find it. Among other things. You can also pet it if you wish. It never hurts a little gratitude to such a loyal friend.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32531663/6b459f5e74ebca526f17faf426fb313a386a3d6f.gif[/img]

I hope you like it and enjoy Flino as much or more than I did by implementing it and giving it life. He may have his faults, but do not be hard on him, he is still very young, and he is learning; just let me know as soon as possible so I can teach him new tricks and improve the ones he already knows.
Also, and at the request of many, from now on you can change the name of the saved games to your liking. In this way you can organize them better.
There is still a long way to go. But little by little EONIA is transforming into that dream that I want to come true. It is an arduous journey, yes, but also fun and very enjoyable thanks to your constant support. Thank you for joining me in this adventure. Thanks for playing EONIA.

notes.title: NPC!!! UPDATE PATCH 0.30.020/2708
notes.content:
EONIA is growing rapidly. This new update is crucial in the history of the game, since it integrates the NPCs. Even though I had to dismiss the initial idea that the Eonios are anthropomorphic beings for various reasons, I am more than satisfied with the new direction decided, and I hope you like the new inhabitants of this wonderful world. EONIA will never feel lonely again!
The game will have almost 100 NPCs. Living in towns, cities and, who knows where! A whole world full of life!
Thus we will meet with the dear Master Enodio, with Lanius, the faithful friend of Albius, with the eight Master Explorers, with the unique and perfect Artist, Writer and Inventor Mivos Esterus, with the alchemist, the botanist, the zoologist, the blacksmith, the carpenter, the musicians, the poets, the sculptors, the jeweler, the farmer, the postmen, and many others who carried out dozens of activities. Also, there are those that will be essential to the story and those who will only tell us the tales, legends and stories, or simply give us a greeting. But that will not prevent them from being intriguing or interesting.
There will be dozens of merchants with whom we can buy, sell and even exchange the most varied items! Without forgetting the mysterious Nomads! That will travel the roads from site to site. And of course, the ... well, I do not want to spoil the surprise.
There is still a long way to go. But little by little EONIA is transforming into that dream that I want to come true. It is an arduous journey, yes, but also fun and very enjoyable thanks to your constant support. Thank you for joining me in this adventure. Thanks for playing EONIA.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE PATCH 0.25.115/1408
notes.content:
I have finished shaping the gameplay of this new EONIA, and I have also rethought about the types of ingredients that are obtained from animals. An also adding new missions and many improvements!

Regarding the gameplay, I made important changes to the "The pass is blocked off" mission, so that it matches with the new idea of the game and with the changes made in the previous big update. From now on, the Ampala will no longer be killed by the beetle, but fled in terror at his presence. Besides, as a new addition, it will be noted that the Jovaris now rest passively at the entrance of their cave once the invader leaves.

There is a redesign of the ingredients that were already in the game and there are several new ones. Now the fish will get scales, eggs and more. You can also find ingredients from both the Ampala and the Jovaris that you will find useful to make potions in a nearby update, among other things.

New mission (WIP)! If you have the soul of a hunter, you are in luck. It is known that ingredients can be obtained from every EONIA living being. But how to do it if it is not possible to kill them? Simple! Trapping them! Now you can build cages and attract those animals with an appetizing bait! Even the big and dangerous ones! But, of course, first you will have to learn how to build those cages with the help of Master Hunter, and also to know which is the preferred food of that creature you want to catch. For this, it will be necessary to draw it, compare it in one of the many Bestiariums, learn in this way what bait it is necessary and collect it in the wide areas of the world and then put it in the cage, that you  learned to make and build with wood, nails and other necessary materials that you had to gather, and finally capture your prey. After obtaining what you need from it, without forgetting that to collect certain ingredients will be necessary jars and some special tools, you will release it to wander free and be useful again after a while. Infinite ingredients! Sure, with a little patience.

New task! Is it monotonous to have to use the boat constantly to go to the island of the fishing pier? Now you can repair a direct path, so you do not have to repeat it! As long as you have all the necessary materials, of course!

Thank you all for making it possible for EONIA to improve day by day! In the next big update, I hope to finish the long-delayed huge cave. As you know, something has happened in my life that has affected the development time of the game. But I’m back working full time and you will see updates and improvements quicker and with much and richer content. As an advance, I can anticipate you that soon you will be able to find the first enemies of the game. Those against whom you must fight with swords, shields, spears, traps, poisons and, well, I do not want to spoil the surprise! But those enemies only want to eliminate you from the surface of the known world. So, have no mercy with them!
I cannot wait to show you all this and much more! I hope you like this update, and I would appreciate if you told me what you think about this. EONIA is very special to me, and I hope that, in one way or another, it can be for you too. Thanks, and regards!


MAIN CHANGES & ADDITIONS

- Lots of spelling corrections.
- Lots of improvements and fixes.
- Quest fixes and improvements.
- Performance improvements.
- Terrain fixes and improvements.
- Changes and improvements in the landscape.
- UI fixes and improvements.
- In the sheet of each skill in the Skill Tree, it indicates if it was already learned or not.
- All animals have their name.
- New quests!
- New task!
- New ingredients! (Jovari poop! But do not forget to grab it with a jar! And cover your nose!)
- Redesign of some ingredients.
- The name of the jars has been changed. Its usefulness has been expanded.
- and more!!!


I really appreciate your feedback! If you would find any issue, please don’t hesitate to let me know as soon as possible so that I can fix it. Thanks!

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE PATCH 0.25.001/3007
notes.content:
I’ve been analyzing certain aspects regarding the gameplay, the history, the lore, and how all this set would fit better into the game, and I decided to make some important changes. The most notorious is the first mission: "The tasks of Master Enodio", and how the situation with the Escarrino is resolved. I have also rewritten, and shortened, all the notes making them more enjoyable for reading and rich in content. There are changes here and there on the world and many improvements. I hope you like it and I would appreciate if you told me what you think about this renewed EONIA.
